o.text: From Proto-Turkic *tiāĺ, compare Turkish taş, Kyrgyz таш (taş), Chuvash чул (čul).
Izafet I compound of ördək (“duck”) + burun (“nose”). Calque of Russian утконо́с (utkonós). Compare Bashkir өйрәкморон (üyräkmurun, “platipus”).

Equivalent to vətən + -pərvər, from Arabic وَطَن (waṭan, “homeland”) and Persian پرور (parvar), from پروردن (parvardan). Compare Ottoman Turkish وطن پرور (vatanparver), where the word appears for the first time in 1860s.
Borrowed from Russian аэрофотогеодезия (aerofotogeodezija). By surface analysis, aerofoto- + geodeziya (“geodesy”).
